quests.title: The Unstamped Arrival
quests.description: You arrived at Weir-Port with a fractured brass soul-tally that marks you outside the Chancery's debt-rolls. Speak with Oar-Keeper Corvus and Clerk Maren to uncover what your tally means.

objectives.text: Speak with Oar-Keeper Corvus on the Weir-Port Ferry Quay
Meet Clerk Maren Vance in the Hall of First Tallies
Report to Chief Archivist Solene in the Audit Archives

quests.title: Ledgers of Smoke
quests.description: Audit Archive discrepancies suggest the Furnace Guild manufactures frontier shortages to seize extra soul-ash. Uncover the Black-Ink Expenditure Ledger and confront Foreman Krag at the Smoking Cinder Kilns.

objectives.text: Recover the Black-Ink Expenditure Ledger from the Audit Archives
Defeat Foreman Krag at the Smoking Cinder Kilns or negotiate with Baron Vane
Present the furnace evidence to Archivist Solene or Magistrate Lyra

quests.title: Three Tolls of the Reach
quests.description: High Auditor Crassus keeps the ancient First Seal chained beneath the Threshold Abyss. Cross Lantern-Wall Bastion into the Pale Reach and gather the three silver fragments of the First Seal: Passage, Memory, and Quiet.

objectives.text: Recover the Fragment of Passage from the Unstamped Scriptorium
Obtain the Fragment of Memory from the Court of the Unwritten (by truce or steel)
Claim the Fragment of Quiet from the Vault of Unpaid Echoes

quests.title: The Scales or the Quiet
quests.description: With all three silver arcs recovered, enter the Sanctum of the First Scale, face High Auditor Crassus, and decide the destiny of Vesper-Threshold: Restore True Quiet, Reform the Chancery, or Seize the Sovereign Scale.

objectives.text: Solve the Inscription of the First Scale and defeat High Auditor Crassus
Speak with the Echo of the Silent Architect or seal your chosen ending

restore_quiet.label: Restore the First Seal of Quiet (Mercy)

seize_scale.label: Claim the Sovereign Scale of Ash (Ruthless)

quests.title: The Ferryman's Oar
quests.description: Cutthroats on the Drowned Piers stole Oar-Keeper Corvus's consecrated ferry-charm. Clear the pier ambush and decide whether to return the charm freely or sell it to Freebooter Rooks.

objectives.text: Defeat the Black-Ledger Pier Ambush at the Drowned Piers
Return to Oar-Keeper Corvus or strike a deal with Tallow-Jack Rooks

return_honest.label: Return the Oar Charm freely to Corvus

sell_smugglers.label: Fence the river pass to Freebooter Rooks

quests.title: Ashes in the Flue
quests.description: Quarry workers led by Dara Iron-Palm are trapped between choking furnace vents and Furnace Guild strikebreakers. Aid the workers or broker a lucrative deal with Baron Vane.

objectives.text: Vent the Main Retort Pressure Wheel or break the Quarry Strikebreakers
Report to Dara Iron-Palm at Penitent's Camp or Baron Vane at the Foundries

side_workers.label: Break the Strikebreakers and free the Quarry Shift

side_baron.label: Take Baron Vane's hush-gold and suppress the strike

quests.title: The Bottled Orchard
quests.description: Savant Elara Glasswright seeks uncorrupted weeping amber from the Weeping Glass Orchard to stabilize the Collegium's decaying memory-archives.

objectives.text: Obtain Weeping Orchard Amber from the Weeping Glass Orchard
Deliver the amber to Savant Elara in the Mnemonic Conservatory

quests.title: Lanterns Along the Viaduct
quests.description: Captain Astrid Voss's scouts along the Rusted Viaduct are pinned down by crystallized salt-jackals and shard-kites. Clear the viaduct raid and restore the border watch.

objectives.text: Defeat the Salt-Jackal Raid on the Rusted Viaduct
Report back to Captain Astrid Voss at Lantern-Wall Bastion

quests.title: Resonance of the Seventh Bell
quests.description: Prior Aldous needs pure Consecrated Bell-Bronze and Fulgurite Ash-Quartz to cast the Seventh Bell of Quiet for Bellwright Square.

objectives.text: Bring Consecrated Bell-Bronze and Fulgurite Ash-Quartz to Prior Aldous

quests.title: Parley of the Hollow Nave
quests.description: The Court of the Unwritten is neither mindless nor feral. Speak with Herald Calen inside the Hollow Nave to negotiate a frontier truce with Regent Malcor, or challenge the Court in open battle.

objectives.text: Negotiate with Herald Calen or face Regent Malcor in the Hollow Nave

quests.title: Refuge for the Debtless
quests.description: [Positive Morality Exclusive] Your reputation for mercy convinces Clerk Maren to trust you with an underground ledger of condemned quarry families. Escort their transit writs safely to Prior Aldous at Bellwright Square.

objectives.text: Deliver Clerk Maren's sanctuary writs to Prior Aldous in Bellwright Square

quests.title: The Unbroken Vow
quests.description: [Positive Morality Exclusive] Serena of the Weeping Orchard recognizes genuine compassion in your aura. Perform Prior Aldous's Rite of Quiet at the Orchard instead of slaying her, releasing her grief and earning her sacred vow-blade.

objectives.text: Speak the Rite of Quiet with Serena in the Weeping Glass Orchard

quests.title: Foreclosure of the Docks
quests.description: [Negative Morality Exclusive] Broker Vespera Null appreciates your unsentimental ruthlessness. Help her seize delinquent pier contracts from the Salt-Wick Boardinghouse and collect a handsome share of the Velvet Court auction.

objectives.text: Intimidate the Salt-Wick debtors and report back to Broker Vespera at the Drowned Piers

quests.title: Tithe of the Unforgiven
quests.description: [Negative Morality Exclusive] Lord-Auctioneer Kestrel offers a forbidden commission reserved only for the ruthless: raid the Vault of Unpaid Echoes for the Condensed Sovereign Ash-Core and claim the Cinder-Debt Executioner Glaive.

objectives.text: Bring the Condensed Sovereign Ash-Core from the Echo Vault to Lord-Auctioneer Kestrel

quests.title: The Drowned Charter
quests.description: You uncovered a pre-Chancery river charter beneath the Drowned Piers AND matched it against the Inflated Conscription Roll in the Audit Archives. Bring this legal bombshell to Magistrate Lyra Thorne.

objectives.text: Present the Pre-Chancery River Charter to Magistrate Lyra at the High Chancery

quests.title: Lament of the Silent Architect
quests.description: By recovering the Silent Architect's Stone Tablet in the Unstamped Scriptorium after reaching truce or compassion in the Ossuary, you unlocked the Architect's final secret at the Broken Ferry-Arch.

objectives.text: Show the Stone Tablet to the Echo of the Silent Architect at the Broken Ferry-Arch

quests.title: The Thirteenth Chime
quests.description: Ringing the Thirteenth Chime and cracking the Pendulum Relay Vault exposed the secret pact between High Auditor Crassus and Furnace Baron Vane. Deliver the seal to Captain Astrid Voss to turn Lantern-Wall Bastion against the conspiracy.

objectives.text: Deliver the Secret Auditor-Furnace Pact to Captain Astrid Voss at Lantern-Wall Bastion

quests.title: Passage Beyond the Salt
quests.description: You assembled all three ancient Frontier Salt-Charms across the Viaduct, Salt-Flats, and Whispering Mire. Bring the complete Triad to Old Cairn-Keeper Yarrow to witness the forgotten Pre-Chancery Ferry.

objectives.text: Present the three Salt-Charms to Old Cairn-Keeper Yarrow at the Field of Drifting Cairns
